subject: english_language_arts
framework: Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts & Literacy
description: CCSS Grade 6–8 ELA — literary and informational text units mapped to Reading Literature (RL), Reading Informational (RI), Writing (W), Language (L), and Speaking & Listening (SL). Each unit includes genre tags, CCSS standard codes, and scenario seeds for session generation.
